title: rulekit fact model
description: The contract between a rule set and a patient record: which facts exist, what type each carries, and — for numbers — the unit they are stated in. A rule set names one fact model in its `factModel` field; every `fact` reference in it must resolve here.

name.description: Versioned model name, e.g. `patient-facts/v1`. Bump the version when a fact is removed, retyped, or has its unit changed.

facts.description: Declared facts, keyed by name. Names are snake_case by convention; `lab_<slug>` marks a fact flattened out of a structured record rather than stated by a human.

unit.description: UCUM-style unit the value is stated in. Optional, but a numeric fact without a declared unit cannot raise the `unit-mismatch` warning, so declare one.

systems.description: Code systems permitted for this fact. A criterion citing a system outside this list is the `unknown-code-system` error.
